title: AgentCore CLI & dev tooling
hook: Idea → running agent in minutes: CLI, starter toolkit, and skills for AI coding assistants.

kv.v: Create, configure, deploy, and manage agents and AgentCore resources from the terminal.
Packaged knowledge for coding assistants (Claude Code, Kiro, Q Developer) so they scaffold AgentCore projects correctly.
Deploys a local agent to AgentCore with zero infrastructure setup; SDK is Python-first.

back.hookline: AWS is optimizing for agents that build agents — the CLI and skills exist so your coding assistant can drive AgentCore.

cli_timeline.template: The AgentCore CLI launched in public preview in February 2026 and reached general availability in March 2026, managing the full agent lifecycle from one interface. April 2026 added the Agent Inspector, resource import, and bash commands inside the agent’s runtime.

cli_timeline.seed_text: April 2026 shipped a developer-experience wave: the AgentCore CLI for managing the full agent lifecycle from one interface, plus AgentCore skills that teach coding assistants how to build on the platform.
cli_timeline.unresolvable_reason: Prose describing a feature timeline. The release notes attest the months (CLI preview February 2026, GA March 2026, features April 2026) but composing them into a sentence is authorship, so this slot is Tier C and cannot be resolved deterministically.
